title: What If All The Oceans Vanished Overnight?

scenes.narration: You wake up. You go to the beach. And the ocean is gone. Every ocean. Everywhere.
scenes.image_prompt: POV standing on a beach looking at an endless empty seabed stretching to the horizon, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: Ships lie on the sand for miles. Shipwrecks from centuries ago see sunlight for the first time.
scenes.image_prompt: POV walking across a dry seabed past ancient shipwrecks and modern cargo ships, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: Fish are everywhere. The smell reaches cities a hundred miles inland.
scenes.image_prompt: POV of a vast seabed scattered with stranded sea life, gulls circling, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: Within weeks, rain stops. Most rain started as ocean water. Rivers start to shrink.
scenes.image_prompt: POV of a cracked dry riverbed under a cloudless burning sky, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: Tiny ocean plants made about half the oxygen we breathe. That supply just switched off.
scenes.image_prompt: POV of a dry seabed where green algae used to be, a faint oxygen chart overlay, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: But you can now walk from New York to London. And the deepest trench is a canyon seven miles down.
